metadata.description: Local policy checks and offline receipt verification for Claude Code. Coverage depends on the configured hooks and tools; verification requires the expected signing key.

plugins.name: protect-mcp
plugins.description: Check routed Claude Code tool calls against local Cedar policies and record signed decisions. Requires Claude Code 2.1.295 or later and a running local gate. Includes explicit MCP evaluation and receipt tools.

plugins.name: verify-mcp
plugins.description: Offline verifier for signed receipts, audit bundles, and trust artifacts. Ed25519 + JCS, no accounts, no network calls. The companion to protect-mcp: it checks what the gate decided with the operator's software removed.
